phases.title: Survival
phases.goal: Greet people, introduce yourself, and handle the most basic café and street interactions.
can: Master greetings and register: oi/olá, bom dia/boa tarde/boa noite, tudo bem?
Conjugate ser and estar in the present and know when to use each
Count 0–30 and give your phone number and age
Use the mandatory contractions no/na/do/da/ao and the crase à
Ask survival questions with quanto custa?, onde fica?, você fala inglês?
Recognize nasal sounds ã/õ/-ão and the ç, lh, nh spellings
phases.daily: 10 min greetings/audio, 10 min ser vs estar drills, 5 min numbers aloud, 5 min copying accented words by hand

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Talk about your daily routine, family, and preferences in simple present-tense sentences.
can: Conjugate regular -ar, -er, and -ir verbs across all persons
Build the near future with ir + infinitive (vou falar, vamos comer)
Express likes with gostar de and obligation with ter que + infinitive
Use estar + gerúndio for what is happening right now (estou estudando)
Handle gender/number agreement of nouns and adjectives (o carro novo, as casas brancas)
Place object pronouns before the verb in Brazilian style (ele me viu)
phases.daily: 15 min verb conjugation, 10 min a short dialogue, 10 min vocab flashcards (family, food, city)

phases.title: Core Structures
phases.goal: Narrate past events and connect ideas across two past tenses and everyday connectors.
can: Use the pretérito perfeito for finished actions, incl. irregulars fui/tive/fiz
Use the pretérito imperfeito for habits and background (eu era, brincava)
Choose correctly between perfeito and imperfeito when telling a story
Form comparatives and superlatives (mais alto do que, o mais…de, melhor/pior)
Use relative clauses with que and quem to join sentences
Apply diminutives -inho/-inha naturally (cafezinho, um minutinho)
phases.daily: 15 min past-tense narration writing, 10 min listening to a podcast or song, 10 min reviewing perfeito vs imperfeito

phases.title: Fluency
phases.goal: Express wishes, hypotheses, and opinions using the subjunctive and conditional with confidence.
can: Form and trigger the present subjunctive (espero que fale, talvez seja)
Use the future subjunctive after quando/se (quando eu for, se você quiser)
Use the conditional for politeness and hypotheticals (gostaria, viajaríamos)
Handle the personal infinitive when subjects differ (é importante vocês chegarem)
Build passive voice with ser + particípio and the passive se (vende-se)
Report speech with tense shifts (ele disse que estava cansado)
phases.daily: 20 min subjunctive/conditional practice, 15 min conversation or shadowing, 10 min reading news in Portuguese

phases.title: Mastery
phases.goal: Communicate with near-native nuance across registers, idioms, and complex hypotheticals.
can: Use the imperfect subjunctive in unreal conditions (se eu fosse rico, viajaria)
Build the third conditional (se eu tivesse sabido, teria vindo)
Use compound tenses tenho falado and tinha falado with correct meaning
Switch between Brazilian and European clitic placement and vocabulary
Handle regional slang and idioms (beleza, valeu, dar um jeito, saudade)
Adapt register from casual (você/a gente) to formal (o senhor/a senhora)
phases.daily: 30 min immersion (films, books, debate), 15 min writing essays, 10 min idiom and slang logging
